title: Felix and the Signal
author: Wren Marchetti
blurb: Coral Joubert, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
